scope: Offline algebraic and rendered invariance only. No A1-C, new inference, correction efficacy, gauge fitting or Q0-HK calibration claim.

representation.metric: x=C*raw; Sigma_x=C^2*Sigma_raw; metric placement=(a,R,t)=gauge@raw_pose with linear block divided by C
representation.reallocation: x'=q*x; Sigma_x'=q^2*Sigma_x; placement linear'=placement linear/q; then absorb remaining scale
representation.standard_deviation: std_y=a*std_x; quaternion and camera origin t unchanged
representation.attributes: Preserve candidate IDs/order, frozen native-active mask, RGB/SH/opacity, raw local rotations and source provenance. Canonical std/covariance intentionally change.

negative_controls.mean_only_absorption: Absorb a into means but keep metric local covariance; detect world covariance error for nonunit a
negative_controls.naive_scale_removal: Set placement scale to one but keep metric local means; preserve correct canonical covariance to isolate wrong means

render.note: Depth error on the intersection of both covered masks over the whole image; any coverage-mask disagreement independently fails. RGB compared unclamped float outputs; saved display RGB clipped only for PNG.

renderer: Existing E4 compact CUDA, float32, TF32 disabled; render identical views for all variants and repeat baseline once for determinism. Positive maps and intentional negative controls stored separately.

office2.reference_status: Dense Replica GT; saved global prefix gauge reused, no new GT fit

HKairport01.reference_status: REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED unchanged: rendering invariance does not validate LiDAR calibration or Terra physical-camera equivalence

access: Existing office2 and HKairport01 only; office3 and office4 predictions untouched. No new dataset acquisition or outbound messages.
decision: PASS only if every native-active candidate passes algebraic/packed/attribute and provenance checks, all registered positive render cases pass, and intentional nonunit-scale errors are rejected. PASS authorizes preparation of A1-C, not automatic execution or a correction GO.
